english.name: Wakey Wakey!
english.description: Thanks for waking me up!

schinese.name: 醒醒啦！
schinese.description: 谢谢你唤醒我！

english.name: Need a Hand?
english.description: Find the severed hand while fishing early.

schinese.name: 搭把手？
schinese.description: 在游戏前期钓鱼时找到断手。

english.name: Welcome Home
english.description: Enjoy your new bedroom.

schinese.name: 欢迎回家
schinese.description: 好好享受你的新卧室吧。

english.name: Pet Me?
english.description: Thanks for petting me!

schinese.name: 摸摸我？
schinese.description: 谢谢你摸摸我！

english.name: You're So Talented
english.description: Play the drum 20 times.

schinese.name: 你真有才！
schinese.description: 敲鼓20次。

english.name: Tastes Like Gwandma
english.description: Cook Dead Gwandma in Cauldron's new dish.

schinese.name: 尝起来像奶耐
schinese.description: 把死掉的奶耐交给坩埚做进新菜里。

english.name: Anywhere But Here
english.description: Leave Morton with Lloyd.

schinese.name: 去哪儿都好，别待这儿
schinese.description: 把莫顿留在劳埃德身边。

english.name: Good Listener
english.description: Listen to Lloyd read his poetry for 1 minute.

schinese.name: 耐心听众
schinese.description: 听劳埃德朗诵诗歌1分钟。

english.name: Leaf Me Alone
english.description: Find Treevor and leaf him alone.

schinese.name: 树沃想静静
schinese.description: 找到树沃，然后让他静静。

english.name: Cheers!
english.description: Have Morton greet a familiar friend in Toot's Tavern.

schinese.name: 干杯！
schinese.description: 让莫顿在图特酒馆向一位老朋友问好。

english.name: My Button
english.description: Use the Buddy Button 20 times.

schinese.name: 我的按钮
schinese.description: 按下伙伴按钮20次。

english.name: Wish Come True
english.description: Make a wish in the well.

schinese.name: 愿望成真
schinese.description: 对着井许个愿。

english.name: Friend or Phone
english.description: Discover Phoney.

schinese.name: 朋友还是机友？
schinese.description: 发现假机友。

english.name: The Sword
english.description: You found The Sword!

schinese.name: 那把剑
schinese.description: 你找到那把剑了！

english.name: How Does it Taste?
english.description: Try the pond water.

schinese.name: 味道如何？
schinese.description: 尝尝池塘里的水。

english.name: Sweet Dreams
english.description: Sleep so I can makes things better.

schinese.name: 做个好梦
schinese.description: 睡吧，这样我就能把一切变好。

english.name: Natural Leader
english.description: Recruit your party.

schinese.name: 天生领袖
schinese.description: 招募你的队伍成员。

english.name: Free Novak
english.description: I don't think he did anything wrong.

schinese.name: 解救诺瓦克
schinese.description: 我觉得他没做错什么。

english.name: Levi the Lever
english.description: Help Levi finally find his place in the world.

schinese.name: 拉杆利维
schinese.description: 帮拉杆利维终于找到自己在世上的归宿。

english.name: The Shape Gang
english.description: Defeat the Shape Gang.

schinese.name: 图形帮
schinese.description: 击败图形帮。

english.name: A New Bard
english.description: Help Bronkh find the perfect bard to mentor.

schinese.name: 新晋吟游诗人
schinese.description: 帮布隆克找到一名合适的吟游诗人收作徒弟。

english.name: Flawless Friendship
english.description: Make it through a fight without you or your friends getting hurt.

schinese.name: 无瑕友谊
schinese.description: 赢下一场战斗，且你和伙伴们都不受伤。

english.name: Our Hero!
english.description: Defeat the Snoodlewonker once and for all.

schinese.name: 我们的英雄！
schinese.description: 彻底击败斯努德沃克。

english.name: Our New Town
english.description: Name the town to the north!

schinese.name: 我们的新小镇
schinese.description: 给北边的小镇取个名字！

english.name: I'm Speechless
english.description: Achieve every achievement in our game. You really do care.

schinese.name: 我都说不出话了
schinese.description: 获得我们游戏里的每一项成就。你真的很在乎我。

english.name: This is it
english.description: This is our perfect ending.

schinese.name: 就是这样
schinese.description: 这就是属于我们的完美结局。

english.name: Against the World
english.description: You and I against the world. Don't forget that, okay?

schinese.name: 与全世界为敌
schinese.description: 你和我一起对抗全世界。别忘了，好吗？

english.name: Forgive Me
english.description: I should have known better.

schinese.name: 原谅我
schinese.description: 我早该明白的。

english.name: Pointless
english.description: I do not exist, because I eventually won't exist.

schinese.name: 毫无意义
schinese.description: 我并不存在，因为终有一天我将不复存在。
